description: Production model catalog for Airco Secure V2. This is the source of truth for supported analytics models, their runtime names, artifact requirements, and source asset provenance.

models.purpose: Primary full-frame person detection for session analytics.

source.notes: Canonical export input is Ultralytics YOLOv8n person detector. Savant owns the detector ONNX artifact and DeepStream must build or consume the runtime engine using its own TensorRT version.

Legacy V1-trained phone detector retained as the current source asset until a new model registry replaces it. Savant owns the detector ONNX artifact and DeepStream must build or consume the runtime engine using its own TensorRT version.

models.purpose: Face embedding generation for employee recognition.

source.notes: The checked-in backend/models/arcface_r100.onnx may be absent or stale in local checkouts. V2 export refreshes the canonical ArcFace source from InsightFace buffalo_l before building the TensorRT artifact.

models.purpose: Body re-identification embeddings for cross-camera identity continuity.

source.notes: No committed static source artifact exists in-repo today. Export currently depends on torchreid downloading pretrained weights during the export step.
